newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DEADLINE TO SUBMIT OFFERS ON TELECOM EXPIRES.
newsitem.headline: DEADLINE TO SUBMIT OFFERS ON TELECOM EXPIRES.

text.p: Lithuania's European affairs ministry said on Wednesday that the deadline to submitt offers to become a lead government advisor for Telecom privatisation expires today.
"It is known that the offers for the tender will be submitted by no more that eight contestors," the ministry said in a statement.
"The open tender commission will start consideration of the offers on Thursday ," the director of the ministry's privatisation department, Vytenis Junevichius, told Reuters.
"It is expected to decide on the winner at the end of this week or the next week," Junevichius added.

Twenty-three banks, consultancies and law firms expressed their interest to become a lead advisor to the government on Telecom privatisation last month and the government decided on a short list of ten.
Union Bank of Switzerland, Merrill Lynch and Creditanstalt Investment Bank were among the ten on the short list.
The deadline to submit the offers expires on Wednesday, 6 p.m.
